# ChapterBuilder compatibility fixture

`tns-2xko-36-chapters.json` is byte-identical to ChapterBuilder's checked-in export fixture.

- VOD provenance: https://youtu.be/un-_oJrC-RI
- Event provenance: https://www.start.gg/tournament/tns-2xko-36/events
- Timeline duration: `03:09:51`

The fixture contains public match names and timestamps only. It deliberately uses no 2XKO-specific
fields: all game-specific text stays inside the game-neutral `name` and `outputName` strings.
